title: Fix lifecycle compatibility guidance
summary: Development guidance and code examples were corrected across multiple AL development topics including error handling, events, upgrades, APIs, and lifecycle management to align with current platform capabilities and best practices.
key_points: Clarified examples and documentation for error collection with ErrorBehavior, event handling with IsHandled, and data transfer skipping triggers
Updated API versioning guidance to require separate page objects for version-specific shapes and aligned examples with APIVersion defaulting to beta
Corrected lifecycle guidance for obsoletions, public members, and test transaction models with improved samples
Fixed examples for SecretText exposure prevention, interface default implementations, and upgrade tag registration
Enhanced web services review examples and refined upgrade codeunit subtype documentation
quote: correct collectible-error, DataTransfer, upgrade-tag, obsoletion, and test-transaction guidance and samples
